title: Quick guide — Pre-installation (site visit)
what: Here you check whether the room is ready to install a device: space, power, gases and paperwork. This is a real visit, not a desk calculation.
can_do: Start a new visit or continue one you already opened
Mark each requirement as meets, does not meet or pending
steps: Choose company, site, service and the device if it is already in inventory.
Click New visit (or open an existing one) and walk through Data, Requirements and Documents.
Read the result: pending items or a serious fail means the site is not ready. Then download the PDF.

common_errors.fix: Click New visit. There is no evaluation without it.
Use a smaller file and do not close the tab while it uploads.
You do not have edit access. Write to ADMIN.

tips: Treat Pending as not ready to install.
If something structural or electrical fails, leave a photo.
This instrument does not evaluate staff training or clinical operation.
“Not applicable” is excluded from the percentage. An open critical item keeps the site Not approved.
contact: If you cannot see your site or people are missing, write to your organisation ADMIN.
